description: This file defines a singleton class `DockIconManager` responsible for managing the visibility of the macOS Dock icon based on window visibility and user preferences. It observes window state changes and user defaults to dynamically toggle the app's activation policy between regular and accessory modes, controlling whether the Dock icon is shown or hidden.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the visibility of the Dock icon based on window states and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Updates the application's Dock icon visibility according to current window states and user preferences.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the app to show the Dock icon by changing activation policy.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Initializes observers for window changes and user default modifications to trigger visibility updates.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when window visibility or key status changes, prompting a visibility update.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when user preferences related to the Dock icon are changed, triggering a visibility update.
